Case Study: Secondary School — Lagos State

Challenge: A private secondary school in Lagos wanted to introduce a practical technology programme that went beyond computing theory. The school had no existing robotics or electronics equipment, no teachers with embedded systems experience, and a tight budget constraint. The programme needed to be deliverable within an existing timetable slot without requiring additional staff.

Solution: AICORE Academy designed and delivered an eight-week robotics curriculum integrated into the school's technology period. AICORE provided all hardware kits — Arduino Uno boards, sensor modules, motor drivers, and chassis components — and trained two existing technology teachers in a two-day intensive before program launch. The curriculum ran progressively from basic electronics through sensor integration to a final student project week where each group built and demonstrated a robot of their design.

Outcomes: 62 students completed the programme across three class groups 4 student projects demonstrated at end-of-term showcase Both trained teachers able to deliver the curriculum independently in subsequent terms School integrated the programme into its formal technology syllabus

Technologies: Arduino Uno, Ultrasonic sensors, IR sensors, Motor drivers, Scratch/C++, Custom curriculum.
